title: Two tracks at once: engineering and research
body: Across mid-2026, Anita ran a full-time software engineering role at theMonks.tech alongside two concurrent research internships — one on code-mixed Malayalam sentiment analysis at SRM University–AP, one on indirect prompt-injection detection at RV University. The two internships ran the same two months; neither was a side project relative to the other.

title: From hackathon speed to research rigor
body: Anita's 2025 hackathon work (DelAI's 24-hour build, CivicAid's no-code pitch round) rewarded speed. Her 2026 research work (TrustHeritage's 130 controlled verification runs, SAGE-PI's leakage-audited evaluation pipeline) rewards rigor. Both are real skills, and the portfolio treats them as distinct rather than blending them into one undifferentiated 'AI' story.

title: Safety and authenticity as a recurring engineering choice
body: VantaAI detects image-based abuse and deepfakes. LawGorithm flags scam content with NLP. TrustHeritage verifies whether digitized cultural-heritage media has been authentically preserved. Different domains, same underlying pattern: using detection and verification systems to make digital content more trustworthy.

title: Accessibility as architecture, not decoration
body: NeuroBridge's modular feature-activation system exists so a user only sees the support tools relevant to their needs — the design bet was against cognitive overload. fAImer applies the same instinct differently: offline-first sync and multilingual UI for users without reliable connectivity.
